responsibilities: INTERN & TRAINEE IT DEVELOPMENT 1). Khiladi India (Multi-Vendor Sports Ecosystem Platform) Role: Full-Stack Developer – Responsible for complete frontend UI architecture (React.js), backend REST API development (Node.js/Express.js), and database schema design (MongoDB). Key features include:

Multi-Category Marketplace Architecture: Developed a dynamic platform supporting diverse business categories including Sports Shops, Academies, Schools, Coaches, and Event Organizers, allowing distinct data structures for each entity.

Comprehensive Vendor Dashboard: Built a robust dashboard where vendors can manage their specific profiles—shops can manage inventory, academies can schedule classes, and trainers can update availability—in real-time.
Recruitment & Job Portal Module: Implemented a dedicated job section enabling vendors to post vacancies (e.g., for coaches or staff) and review applicant profiles directly through the platform.
Dynamic Content Rendering: Designed a flexible React frontend that adapts the UI layout based on the category selected (e.g., displaying product grids for Shops vs. course lists for Academies).
Search & Filtering Logic: Created advanced filtering APIs allowing users to search for specific equipment, locate nearby academies, or find trainers based on sport type and location.

Reusable Component Library: Built reusable UI components (Movie Cards, Search Bars, Modals) to ensure design consistency across the user and admin portals. Tech. Stack: Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js (MERN) 2). Bruchi Club (Social & Club Management Platform) Role: Full-Stack Developer – Responsible for developing interactive UI features, managing backend logic for user memberships, and database schema design. Key features include:
Membership Management Module: Developed a robust system for user registration, membership plan selection, and profile management using React and Node.js.
Event & Activity Booking: Implemented functionality for members to browse upcoming club events, book slots, and view history, utilizing MongoDB for efficient data retrieval.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Designed a secure backend architecture to differentiate between Admin, Staff, and Member roles, ensuring data privacy.
Interactive UI with Hooks: Utilized React Hooks (useState, useEffect) and Context API to manage global state for user sessions and notifications.

Responsive Design & API Integration: Created a fully responsive frontend ensuring compatibility across devices and integrated backend APIs for real-time data updates. Tech. Stack: Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js (MERN) 3). India Victory News (Digital News Portal & CMS) Role: Full-Stack Developer – Led the development of the Content Management System (CMS) and public-facing news portal using the MERN stack. Key features include:
Dynamic Content Management System (CMS): Built a powerful admin panel for editors/reporters to create, edit, and publish news articles with rich text support and image uploads.
Categorized News Feed: Developed a dynamic frontend using React Router to categorize news (Politics, Sports, Entertainment) and render articles efficiently.
Fast & Scalable Backend: Architected Node.js/Express APIs to handle frequent read operations for news fetching, implementing pagination to optimize load times.
Search & Filtering Mechanism: Implemented advanced search functionality allowing users to filter news by date, category, or keywords using MongoDB aggregation pipelines.

User Engagement Features: Added features for user comments, likes, and social media sharing integration to increase platform engagement. Tech. Stack: Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js (MERN)
